segments.ja320:1.1: Succajaṃ vata naccaji, vācāya adadaṃ giriṃ;
segments.ja320:1.3: Kiṃ hitassa cajantassa, vācāya adada pabbataṃ.
segments.ja320:2.1: Yañhi kayirā tañhi vade, yaṃ na kayirā na taṃ vade;
segments.ja320:3.1: Rājaputta namo tyatthu, sacce dhamme ṭhito casi;
segments.ja320:3.3: Yassa te byasanaṃ patto, saccasmiṃ ramate mano.
segments.ja320:4.1: Yā daliddī daliddassa, aḍḍhā aḍḍhassa kittima [kittimā (sī. syā. pī.)];
segments.ja320:4.3: Sā hissa paramā bhariyā, sahiraññassa itthiyoti.
segments.ja320:7.1: Atha cora sakassapa khantīvaro, dujjīvitatā ca varā pharusā;
segments.ja320:7.3: Atha sasa matañca vasanta sukhaṃ, succajaṃvatanaccajinā ca dasāti.
